fields.value: Strong Public Schools: fully funding Ohio's public schools, supporting teachers, and ensuring classrooms have the resources students need
fields.quote: She supports fully funding Ohio’s public schools, supporting teachers, and ensuring classrooms have the resources students need to succeed.

fields.value: Affordable, Accessible Healthcare: expand access to care, protect coverage for families and children, strengthen support for patients with rare conditions, and ensure veterans receive the services they have earned
fields.quote: She will fight to expand access to care, protect coverage for families and children, strengthen support for patients with rare conditions

fields.value: Support for Veterans and Military Families: improving access to benefits, mental health services, job opportunities, and healthcare
fields.quote: She is committed to improving access to benefits, mental health services, job opportunities, and healthcare for those who have served our country.
